answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond, locked for the epoch and forfeited when two identities are proven to share one operator. A thread of past work must link each claim to earlier verified contributions, so a fresh clone has no history to borrow. The reef of honest participants stays hard to flood, because each fake identity costs a bond, not a free signup. The failure mode is a wealthy attacker funding many bonds, so auditors must re-run a cipher challenge tied to the identity's history and compare it with the record before any reward is released, rejecting mismatches.
